seoTitle: Master of Inventory: Warranty, Receipt and Claim Tracker
metaDescription: Photograph what you own with its receipt and serial number. Get reminders before a warranty ends or a return window closes. Private, free for 15 items.
heroHeadline: Never lose a claim, a warranty or a refund
heroSubhead: Photograph what you own with its price, receipt and serial number. Reminders tell you before a warranty ends or a return window closes, and a claim pack is one tap away when you need proof.
highlights: Reminders before every warranty ends and return window closes
Receipt price and date read on your iPhone
One-tap claim pack with receipt, photos and serial number

features.title: Home shows what is protected
features.body: Your protected value, what needs attention and how many items have a receipt, at a glance.

features.title: Soon: every deadline on one timeline
features.body: Warranties ending and return windows closing, filtered by warranty or returns, with reminders at the time of day you choose.

features.title: Scan, don't type
features.body: Receipt scanning runs on your device and reads the price, date and store. Live Text reads serial numbers, and burst capture lets you photograph several items in a row and fill in the details later.

features.title: A record that holds up
features.body: Each item carries coverage rings, multi-page receipts, serial numbers, locations and a record-strength meter. Organize with colour and icon categories, in a grid or a list, and search by name, brand, serial number, store or notes.

features.title: Claim pack and exports
features.body: One tap bundles the receipt, photos and serial number for a claim. Export a PDF report or a CSV spreadsheet for your insurer or your own files.

features.title: Private by design
features.body: Records stay on your device and sync through your own iCloud when you are signed in. No account, an optional Face ID lock, and Spotlight, Siri and Shortcuts work with your inventory on the phone.

pricing.heading: Free for 15 items. Pro removes the limit.

pricing.footnote: US prices shown; your local price appears in the App Store. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel in your Apple Account settings, and the lifetime unlock never renews. If you bought Master of Inventory when it was paid up front, Pro is yours, free.

faq.q: How much does Master of Inventory cost?
faq.a: It is free for up to 15 items with every core feature. Pro removes the limit and adds the PDF and CSV exports: $4.99 a month, $29.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $59.99 once. Apple handles refunds and cancellations.

faq.q: Where is my data, and is it private?
faq.a: Your records live on your device and sync through your own iCloud account when you are signed in. There is no account and no server of ours that holds your inventory. Only anonymous purchase and usage counts leave your phone, never your items, photos or receipts.
Yes. Capturing items, scanning receipts and browsing your inventory work without a connection, and iCloud catches up the next time you are online.

faq.q: Can I hand my insurer a report?
faq.a: Yes. Pro exports a PDF report and a CSV spreadsheet, and a claim pack bundles one item's receipt, photos and serial number in a tap.

faq.q: Does it remind me about warranties and returns?
faq.a: Yes. Set a warranty length or a return deadline on an item and you get a reminder before it ends, at the time of day you choose, and the Soon tab lists everything that is coming up.

faq.q: Which devices and languages are supported?
faq.a: iPhone and iPad with iOS 18 or later, in 16 languages: English, Danish, German, Spanish, Finnish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Dutch, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Swedish, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
